description: This file defines the RegisterModel class used for user registration in an ASP.NET Razor Pages application. It handles user input, validation, account creation, email confirmation, and sign-in processes for new users.

classes.name: RegisterModel
classes.description: A Razor PageModel class handling user registration, email confirmation, and login for the identity area of the web application.

classes.name: InputModel
classes.description: A nested class representing the user input fields for registration, including email, password, and password confirmation with validation attributes.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the registration page, initializing return URL.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests to register a new user, validating input, creating user account, sending confirmation email, and signing in the user.
